note: Policy watch flags reported changes to fees, thresholds, timelines and rules for the eight destinations. Each item links to its source. Figures on the site are updated by a human after verification — this feed does not rewrite them automatically.

alerts.title: Temporary Graduate (485) application fee doubled to AUD 4,600
alerts.summary: Announced without notice on 1 March 2026, up from AUD 2,300 in place since July 2025. Applicants planning a post-study work application should budget for the revised figure.

alerts.title: India moved to Evidence Level 3 under the Simplified Student Visa Framework
alerts.summary: The highest scrutiny band. Indian applicants must provide more detailed financial documentation and stronger proof of genuine study intent, and may face longer processing.

alerts.title: Study permit approval rate fell to 35.7% in 2025
alerts.summary: The lowest in a decade, following study permit caps and tighter proof-of-funds rules. Indian applicants were refused at a far higher rate than the overall average.
alerts.source: IRCC data via The PIE News
